text: One last sortie over Dnipro before we head south. Your first win here unlocks your branch’s final skill. Attack adds an automatic beam every ten seconds. Defense doubles the experience you earn from campaign targets.
We’re ready. Ever since Lviv he’s had to sniff every sack by the gate. Nothing but nuts and bolts today, much to his disappointment.
Well, I hope he can stay awake without it. A jet will be long gone while the helicopter ahead of you is still settling into a hover. Are you keeping time for him up there?
Have you ever flown on someone who picks his own rhythm?
No. That is why I listen to your reports.
Then here’s my report. He flicked a wing, I ducked, and for once we got through the hangar doors without so much as scratching the paint. The caretaker came out to shake my hand.
